name: riksdagen
description: Sveriges riksdag (riksdagen.se) is the Swedish Parliament's public website. This CLI searches parliamentary documents, members, web-TV, the calendar and news, and fetches detail pages (motions, committee reports, member profiles, videos, calendar events, parties) as CMS JSON through the site's /api/data proxy.

commands.name: search
commands.summary: Search riksdagen.se by keyword. Filter by category (documents, members, web-TV, calendar, news, web pages), document type, party and riksmöte, sort the results, and page through them.

params.name: sok
params.description: Search keyword(s)

params.name: avd
params.description: Result category

params.name: doktyp
params.description: Document type filter, e.g. mot (motion), bet (betänkande), prop (proposition), ip (interpellation), fr (skriftlig fråga). Leave empty for all types.

params.name: parti
params.description: Party abbreviation filter, e.g. S, M, SD, C, V, KD, L, MP. Leave empty for all parties.

params.name: rm
params.description: Riksmöte (parliamentary session) filter, format YYYY/YY, e.g. 2025/26. Leave empty for all sessions.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort key: relevans (relevance), datum (date) or debattdatum (debate date)

params.name: sortorder
params.description: Sort direction

params.name: p
params.description: Result page number, starting at 1

commands.name: list-members
commands.summary: List current members of parliament (ledamöter), optionally filtered by party.

params.name: parti
params.description: Party code in lowercase. Leave empty for all members.

commands.name: get-member
commands.summary: Get a member of parliament's profile: party, constituency, assignments and recent activity (motions, speeches, questions).

params.name: slug
params.description: Member slug in the form name_<intressent-guid>, taken from member listings or search results

commands.source: E2 E95 E98 E114 GET https://www.riksdagen.se/api/data/

commands.name: get-party
commands.summary: Get a party page: description, leadership and members.

params.name: party
params.description: Party page slug

commands.name: get-document
commands.summary: Get a parliamentary document's detail page (motion, betänkande/committee report, föredragningslista, talarlista, etc.) including its proposals, case history, debate and decision.

params.name: doctype
params.description: Document type path segment

params.name: slug
params.description: Document slug, title-slug_<dok_id lowercase>, e.g. klimatpolitik_hd01mju16. Take it from search results.

commands.name: get-planned-chamber-items
commands.summary: Get the list of planned items (upcoming debates and decisions) for the Chamber (kammaren).

commands.name: get-webtv-video
commands.summary: Get a web-TV video (debate) detail: metadata, speaker list and related documents (talarlista, föredragningslista).

params.name: category
params.description: Video category slug, e.g. allmanpolitisk-debatt, partiledardebatt, debatt-om-forslag

params.name: slug
params.description: Video slug, title_<id>, from web-TV search results

commands.name: get-calendar
commands.summary: Get the parliament calendar page (upcoming chamber sessions, committee meetings and events).

commands.name: get-calendar-event
commands.summary: Get a single calendar event's detail (time, place, agenda, related documents).

params.name: category
params.description: Event category slug

params.name: year
params.description: Year, e.g. 2026

params.name: month
params.description: Swedish three-letter month abbreviation, lowercase

params.name: day
params.description: Day of month, e.g. 14

params.name: slug
params.description: Event slug, title_<id>, from calendar search results

commands.name: list-news
commands.summary: Get the latest news (Aktuellt) from the Riksdag.

commands.name: get-news-category
commands.summary: Get a news/theme page under Aktuellt, e.g. valet-2026 or allmanna-motionstiden.

params.name: slug
params.description: News category/theme slug

commands.name: get-page
commands.summary: Generic fallback: fetch the CMS JSON for any riksdagen.se page path, e.g. a search URL with extra filters, an open-data documentation page, or a member page with an activity filter.

params.name: path
params.description: Site path including any query string, starting with /sv/, e.g. /sv/dokument-och-lagar/riksdagens-oppna-data/dokument/

commands.source: E2 E118 E122 E137 E139 GET https://www.riksdagen.se/api/data/

notes: All commands go through GET /api/data/?url=<site path>. This proxy returns the Episerver headless-CMS JSON (contentApiData) for any page.
The site's own _next/data/<buildId>/… URLs depend on a build id that changes on every deploy, so they are not used.
Response shapes are large CMS objects. Search hits, member lists and document metadata are nested inside them, so look for the result or list arrays in the returned JSON.
Slugs for get-document, get-member, get-webtv-video and get-calendar-event come from the URLs in search results. A document slug ends in _<dok_id lowercased>, e.g. _hd023408 for motion 2025/26:3408.
Some slugs contain non-ASCII characters (e.g. militara-fragor_ha01föu4). Pass them unencoded.
Search parti uses uppercase codes (V, S, MP…). list-members parti uses lowercase codes (s, mp…).

The member activity filter (by type) and the calendar day/week views use query parameters that were not fully captured. Use get-page with the full site path, e.g. /sv/ledamoter-och-partier/ledamot/<slug>/?doktyp=mot.

For bulk or structured data (documents, votes, speeches, members), Riksdagen also offers the open REST API at https://data.riksdagen.se/ (dokumentlista, voteringlista, anforandelista, personlista; JSON/XML/CSV). It was not exercised here.
